remarks: Rare find 4-bedroom SINGLE level home in the highly desirable Turtle Rock community! Featuring a welcoming front courtyard, two side courtyards, and an expansive backyard, this home offers seamless indoor-outdoor living. Large sliding glass doors in both the primary and secondary bedrooms open directly onto the courtyards, filling the interiors with abundant natural light and creating a beautiful connection to the outdoors. It is also ideally located within walking distance of Turtle Rock Elementary School, neighborhood parks, community pools, tennis courts, and scenic Turtle Rock trails, with UC Irvine just minutes away.
